styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, the riverfront and the old mill district.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Juicy Lucys, Nordic kitchens and brewery taprooms.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Chain of Lakes, the Mississippi and city parks.

stays.why: Walk to the riverfront, theaters and stadiums; easy light-rail links to the airport and Mall of America.
Lakes, cafés and local shops; a relaxed base south of downtown.
Breweries, art spaces and river paths in old industrial buildings.
Campus energy, cheap eats and the Green Line to both downtowns.

food: Try a Juicy Lucy: a burger with cheese melted inside the patty. Several local bars claim to have invented it.
Look for Nordic and Scandinavian-influenced cooking; the Twin Cities have a strong Nordic food scene.
Grab walleye (a local fish) or a wild rice dish for a taste of Minnesota.
Brewery taprooms are everywhere; many allow outside food or host food trucks.
Check hours before you go: some kitchens close early on weeknights, and many places are closed on Mondays.
more_time: Add a day in St. Paul: the Green Line light rail links both downtowns, with museums and old mansions to see.
Take the Blue Line to Mall of America for shopping and indoor rides on a rainy or cold day.
Head to Minnehaha Park and the river for a half-day of walking and a waterfall.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the riverfront, a museum and the lakes; add a night for St. Paul or Mall of America.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near -4°C, lows near -13°C. Bundle up and plan indoor sights.
Still deep winter: highs near -2°C, lows near -14°C. Watch for icy sidewalks.
Warming slowly: highs near 6°C, lows near -5°C. Expect some rain or snow days.
Spring arrives: highs near 12°C, lows near 1°C. Rain picks up; pack a layer.
Pleasant: highs near 20°C, lows near 9°C. Good for parks and walking.
Warm and green: highs near 27°C, lows near 16°C. Frequent rain showers.
Hottest month: highs near 28°C, lows near 18°C. Stay hydrated; some rain days.
Warm and humid: highs near 27°C, lows near 17°C. Good lake weather.
Comfortable: highs near 24°C, lows near 14°C. Great for outdoor plans.
Cooling down: highs near 14°C, lows near 6°C. Bring a jacket.
Chilly: highs near 6°C, lows near -2°C. Rain or snow possible.
Winter returns: highs near -1°C, lows near -9°C. Pack warm layers.

climate_guide.summary: Continental climate with cold, snowy winters and warm, humid summers. Rain is spread through the year.

items.title: Winters are very cold
items.text: December to February highs sit near -4 to -1°C with lows near -9 to -14°C. Dress in layers and plan indoor stops.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs around 20–28°C. Ideal for the lakes, river paths and outdoor dining.

items.title: Rain in every month
items.text: Rain days range from about 5 to 12 a month, peaking in spring and summer. Carry a light rain jacket.

items.title: Summer can be humid
items.text: July and August highs near 27–28°C with warm nights. Go out early or late on hot days.

items.title: Spring and fall are mild
items.text: April and October highs near 12–14°C. Pleasant for walking but changeable; pack a layer.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Warm coat, hat and gloves in winter; light clothes and rain gear in summer; a jacket for spring and fall.

transit.best: Light rail and buses for most trips; ride apps or a car for scattered sights.

modes.text: METRO Blue Line links the airport, downtown and Mall of America; fare $2 includes a 2.5-hour transfer. The Green Line connects downtown Minneapolis to St. Paul via the University.
Buses cover the city. Use the Metro Transit app or website for routes and schedules. Day passes cost $6; 7-day passes $24 (Go-To card required).
Taxis can be hailed or found at ranks. Uber and Lyft operate.
Driving is common. Rush hours (7-9 AM, 3-7 PM) are congested.
Walking and biking are pleasant in many areas.
